newsitem.title: UK: Mercury World Mining Trust to be wound up - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mercury World Mining Trust to be wound up - paper.

text.p: Mercury World Mining Trust Plc, a flagship investment trust of Mercury Asset Management (MAM), is to be wound up because of its poor share performance, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper said.
MAM had decided it could not justify extending the life of the trust and would therefore distribute the proceeds to shareholders less than four years after it was launched, the paper said.

No one at MAM was immediately available for comment. The trust's investment manager said two weeks ago the share price had fallen 6.1 percent last year but added that the prsopects for 1997 were better.
MAM insiders told the newspaper that it was inconceivable the trust could be allowed to continue while trading at a hefty discount and that institutional investors had had enough.
Mercury World Mining Trust set a record as the biggest ever investment trust launch when it raised 425 million pounds ($692.8 million) in November 1993.
